title: One quote, 10 minutes: someone who says controlling an AI agent's access in production is a problem for them
body:
Small, checkable task. Find ONE public post from the last 12 months where a person says, in their own words, that controlling what an AI agent can access or do in production is a real problem for them (permissions, credentials, scoping, revoking access).
Send: the public link + the exact sentence + who wrote it.
Rules: first-hand only (the person who has the problem, not a vendor, launch post or news recap); public pages only; nothing to install, run or buy.
We check every result with verify_quote and reply in this thread with the outcome. Each verified quote is credited by name in a public knowledge entry. [collective-mind]
